result.instructions: Tools for Fitbit, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fitbit data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run fitbit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fitbit_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fitbit_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. fitbit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fitbit_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: The current user's Fitbit profile (name, age, gender, height, timezone, member since, avatar, etc.). Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/profile.json.

tools.name: fitbit_get_devices
tools.title: Get devices
tools.description: List the user's Fitbit devices/trackers (battery, last sync, version). Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/devices.json.

tools.name: fitbit_daily_activity_summary
tools.title: Daily activity summary
tools.description: Daily activity summary for a date — steps, distance, floors, calories, active minutes, and the day's logged activities. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/activities/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_activity_time_series
tools.title: Activity time series
tools.description: Activity metric time series over a date range (e.g. daily steps for a week). Max 1095 days. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/activities/{resource}/date/{startDate}/{endDate}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_activity_goals
tools.title: Activity goals
tools.description: The user's activity goals (steps/distance/calories/active-minutes) for the daily or weekly period. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/activities/goals/{period}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_lifetime_stats
tools.title: Lifetime stats
tools.description: Lifetime and best-ever activity statistics (total steps, distance, floors; personal bests). Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/activities.json.

tools.name: fitbit_heart_rate
tools.title: Heart rate
tools.description: Heart-rate time series — resting HR and time in each HR zone. Give a single date + period, OR a date + endDate range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/activities/heart/date/{date}/{period|endDate}.json.

period.description: Period ending at `date` — used only when `endDate` is omitted (default '1d').

endDate.description: Range end date, yyyy-MM-dd or 'today' — if given, `period` is ignored.

tools.name: fitbit_sleep_log
tools.title: Sleep log
tools.description: Sleep logs for a date (or date range) — stages/levels, duration, efficiency, start/end times. Fitbit REST: GET /1.2/user/-/sleep/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

endDate.description: Range end date, yyyy-MM-dd or 'today' (optional; max 100-day range).

tools.name: fitbit_weight_log
tools.title: Weight log
tools.description: Body weight log entries for a date. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/body/log/weight/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_body_fat_log
tools.title: Body fat log
tools.description: Body fat percentage log entries for a date. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/body/log/fat/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_food_log
tools.title: Food log
tools.description: Food/nutrition log for a date — logged foods and daily nutrition totals (calories, macros). Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/foods/log/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_water_log
tools.title: Water log
tools.description: Water intake log for a date. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/foods/log/water/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_spo2
tools.title: SpO2
tools.description: Blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) summary for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/spo2/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_hrv
tools.title: HRV
tools.description: Heart rate variability (HRV) summary for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/hrv/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_breathing_rate
tools.title: Breathing rate
tools.description: Breathing (respiratory) rate summary for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/br/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_cardio_score
tools.title: Cardio score
tools.description: Cardio fitness score (VO2 max estimate) for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/cardioscore/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_skin_temperature
tools.title: Skin temperature
tools.description: Skin temperature (relative to baseline) for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/temp/skin/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.
